mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2200 units, indicating strengthened consumer demand, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs decrease.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthened supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as operational efficiencies improve.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in stabilization periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annualized growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% indicates slowing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate decreased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, with higher rates relative to the average leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or the relationship between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth is above 1.5% month-over-month, the combined labor market strength boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, an increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average signals strengthened consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window in post-shock recovery regimes, or the relationship between RSAFS and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in these regimes.
